mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS) AS "userCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOG_FILES) AS "fileCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INSPECTIONS WHERE INS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED') AS "inspectionCount", (SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_LINES), 0) FROM INSPECTIONS WHERE INS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED') AS "totalLineCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT R.INS_NO, R.LINE_NO FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R JOIN INSPECTIONS I ON R.INS_NO = I.INS_NO WHERE I.INS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY R.INS_NO, R.LINE_NO )) AS "abnormalLogCount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R JOIN INSPECTIONS I ON R.INS_NO = I.INS_NO WHERE I.INS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED') AS "detectionCount" FROM DUAL

SELECT TO_CHAR(D.STAT_DATE, 'MM-DD') AS "statDate", COUNT(I.INS_NO) AS "inspectionCount", NVL(SUM(NVL(R.ABNORMAL_COUNT, 0)), 0) AS "abnormalLogCount" FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (7 - LEVEL) AS STAT_DATE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 7 ) D LEFT JOIN INSPECTIONS I ON TRUNC(I.START_DATE) = D.STAT_DATE AND I.INS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT INS_NO, COUNT(DISTINCT LINE_NO) AS ABNORMAL_COUNT FROM DETECTION_RESULTS GROUP BY INS_NO ) R ON I.INS_NO = R.INS_NO GROUP BY D.STAT_DATE ORDER BY D.STAT_DATE

SELECT D.DET_RULE_TYPE AS "ruleType", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R JOIN DETECTION_RULES D ON R.DET_NO = D.DET_NO JOIN INSPECTIONS I ON R.INS_NO = I.INS_NO WHERE I.INS_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY D.DET_RULE_TYPE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT I.INS_NO, I.FILE_NO, I.INS_STATUS, I.TOTAL_LINES, I.ERROR_COUNT, I.START_DATE, F.FILE_NAME, F.SOURCE_TYPE, U.USER_ID, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT R.LINE_NO) FROM DETECTION_RESULTS R WHERE R.INS_NO = I.INS_NO ) AS "abnormalLogCount" FROM INSPECTIONS I JOIN LOG_FILES F ON I.FILE_NO = F.FILE_NO JOIN USERS U ON F.USER_NO = U.USER_NO ORDER BY I.INS_NO DESC
SELECT USER_NO, USER_ID, USER_EMAIL, ROLE, REG_DATE, BLOCK_YN FROM USERS ORDER BY USER_NO DESC
